items.author: Trump
items.text: There has been no greater President that stands with American Farmers and Ranchers than President Donald J. Trump!As l've stated before, I was the last President to get a Farm Bill done in 2018. IT IS TIME TO DO IT AGAIN, and FAST. Our Great Farmers and Ranchers NEED and DESERVE certainty ahead of the 2027 planting season because FOOD SECURITY IS NATIONAL SECURITY!Congressional Republican Majorities, YOU MUST PASS A NEW FARM BILL DURING THE REMAINING DAYS OF CONGRESS. FARMERS AND RANCHERS ARE NOT INTERESTED IN FURTHER DELAYS. Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRU
items.summary_cn: 特朗普敦促国会尽快通过新农业法案，以在2027年种植季前为美国农民提供政策确定性。
